title: Projects and Auto · 0.5.0
description: Your Lumen projects on your iPhone, in sync with the web, and Auto, which picks the best of your models for each message and says why.
notes: Projects from the web appear in the sidebar; open one to see its chats and instructions.
Start a chat inside a project and its instructions go with every message, as on the web.
Create, rename or delete projects and edit their instructions; changes appear on the web too.
Touch and hold a chat to move it into a project or out of one.
Auto, first in the model list, picks the best connected model for each message: code, writing, photos, quick questions.
If the chosen provider is at its limit or down, Auto moves to the next model it picked.
Each reply shows which model answered, and with Auto, why.
